summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on diagnosing why adding frames to the RZK system did not result in expected traffic data appearing in the campaign manager. It was suggested that the issue might stem from how demographic data is aggregated, as it typically rolls up to a master facility for optimization, potentially causing the traffic query to fail or miss data.

One user noted that removing a specific check (`facility_num > 0`) seemed to resolve the immediate problem. Another point raised was that when calculating totals, all areas might default to a single area, suggesting that waiting for further updates might be necessary.
decisions: The current setup regarding frames and traffic reporting will not be changed; they agreed to wait for more information.
action_items: Someone needs to rewrite the query due to issues with demographic data aggregation.
